description: Seamless continuation across sessions and IDEs — on session start, read .toh/memory/ and greet the user with where the last session left off so nothing needs re-explaining. Handles first run (no memory yet), mid-task resume, and returns after days or weeks. Use at the start of every new session or when the user says continue / "ทำต่อ".
